newsitem.title: USA: CCC seeks 3,000 tonnes soymeal Aug 26 for Georgia.
newsitem.headline: CCC seeks 3,000 tonnes soymeal Aug 26 for Georgia.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp said Tuesday it will tender on August 26 to buy 3,000 tonnes of U.S. 48 percent protein soybean meal for donation to the Republic of Georgia.
The shipment period is September 10 to 30, 1997.

CCC said phytosanitary certification was required with the meal sought at 48.0 percent protein (minimum 47.5 percent), 12.0 percent moisture (maximum 12.5 percent), minimum fat 0.5 percent, and maximum fiber 3.5 percent in bulk.
The transaction is under Title II of the PL-480 law.
